```sql
WITH cohorts AS (
    -- Get each customer's cohort (signup month) and their ID
    SELECT
        id AS customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)::DATE AS cohort_month
    FROM customers
),
cohort_sizes AS (
    -- Count total customers per cohort
    SELECT
        cohort_month,
        COUNT(customer_id) AS cohort_size
    FROM cohorts
    GROUP BY cohort_month
),
customer_order_months AS (
    -- Get distinct months each customer placed an order
    SELECT DISTINCT
        o.customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::DATE AS order_month
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.status != 'cancelled'
),
cohort_activity AS (
    -- Join customers with their order activity and calculate month number
    SELECT
        c.cohort_month,
        com.order_month,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(com.order_month, c.cohort_month)) * 12 +
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE(com.order_month, c.cohort_month)) AS months_since_signup,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS active_customers
    FROM cohorts c
    JOIN customer_order_months com ON c.customer_id = com.customer_id
    WHERE com.order_month >= c.cohort_month
    GROUP BY
        c.cohort_month,
        com.order_month
),
cohort_retention AS (
    -- Calculate retention percentage for each cohort and period
    SELECT
        ca.cohort_month,
        ca.months_since_signup,
        cs.cohort_size,
        ca.active_customers,
        ROUND(
            (ca.active_customers::DECIMAL / cs.cohort_size) * 100, 2
        ) AS retention_percentage
    FROM cohort_activity ca
    JOIN cohort_sizes cs ON ca.cohort_month = cs.cohort_month
)
-- Pivot the data to show months as columns (up to 12 months)
SELECT
    cohort_month,
    cohort_size,
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 0  THEN retention_percentage END) AS "Month 0",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 1  THEN retention_percentage END) AS "Month 1",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 2  THEN retention_percentage END) AS "Month 2",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 3  THEN retention_percentage END) AS "Month 3",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 4  THEN retention_percentage END) AS "Month 4",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 5  THEN retention_percentage END) AS "Month 5",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 6  THEN retention_percentage END) AS "Month 6",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 7  THEN retention_percentage END) AS "Month 7",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 8  THEN retention_percentage END) AS "Month 8",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 9  THEN retention_percentage END) AS "Month 9",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 10 THEN retention_percentage END) AS "Month 10",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 11 THEN retention_percentage END) AS "Month 11",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 12 THEN retention_percentage END) AS "Month 12"
FROM cohort_retention
GROUP BY
    cohort_month,
    cohort_size
ORDER BY
    cohort_month;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', c.created_at)::DATE AS cohort_month,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::DATE AS order_month,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE(DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date), DATE_TRUNC('month', c.created_at)))::INT AS months_after_signup,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customers_in_cohort,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers_with_order,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id), 2) AS retention_percentage
FROM 
    customers c
LEFT JOIN 
    orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id 
    AND DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) >= DATE_TRUNC('month', c.created_at)
WHERE 
    c.created_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', c.created_at),
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)
ORDER BY 
    cohort_month,
    months_after_signup;
```

```sql
WITH customer_cohorts AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS cohort,
        id
    FROM
        customers
),
customer_activity AS (
    SELECT
        c.id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS activity_month
    FROM
        orders o
    JOIN
        customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
),
cohort_activity AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cohort,
        ca.activity_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ca.id) AS active_customers
    FROM
        customer_cohorts cc
    JOIN
        customer_activity ca ON cc.id = ca.id
    GROUP BY
        cc.cohort, ca.activity_month
),
cohort_sizes AS (
    SELECT
        cohort,
        COUNT(id) AS cohort_size
    FROM
        customer_cohorts
    GROUP BY
        cohort
),
cohort_retention AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cohort,
        ca.activity_month,
        ca.active_customers,
        cs.cohort_size,
        (ca.active_customers::DECIMAL / cs.cohort_size) * 100 AS retention_rate
    FROM
        cohort_sizes cs
    JOIN
        cohort_activity ca ON cs.cohort = ca.cohort
)
SELECT
    cohort,
    activity_month,
    retention_rate
FROM
    cohort_retention
ORDER BY
    cohort, activity_month;
```
